CODE RED B0 REALIZATION. This is the artifact-binding successor to the policy court, not another rights review.

Exact paths:
- docs/data/sherlock/README.md
- docs/data/sherlock/source-manifest.json
- docs/data/sherlock/annotation-lineage.json
- docs/data/sherlock/recall-lineage.json
- docs/data/sherlock/alias-map.json
- docs/data/sherlock/timebase-repair.json

No other repository path. Actual episode video bytes remain external and are never copied. The records may contain shareable hashes, byte counts, stream metadata, artifact and release identities, transforms, axis definitions, row/source identifiers and admission receipts. Do not reproduce participant prose or episode content in this manifest slice.

Required facts and independent axes: both media-part byte and stream identities; exact experimental-edition claim either established or explicitly unconfirmed; pinned annotation artifact and reproducible workbook-to-TSV lineage; all 17 recall source exports and reproducible public-release-to-local mapping; checked 17-source alias mapping including the omitted source and shifted numbering; separate part-local media, annotation-run, scanner/TR, recall and repaired coordinates; two-run repair receipt with missingness and the 10.8 second media tail; distinct Microsegment1000, Scene50 and recall-tuned TopicHmmEvent30 populations; feature-use restriction that TopicHmmEvent30 is diagnostic, never independent gold; ordinary story-text admission outcome for every text-bearing artifact proposed for use.

Gate: canonical JSON parse and deterministic canonical digest for every record; all referenced local hashes reverified without printing content; 2 media parts and 17 recall sources exactly; alias mapping total and one-to-one over the 16 aliases with the one omitted source explicit; transform replay digests match; timebase repair is pure and separately receipted; no raw-video file is tracked or copied; no participant prose occurs in the six paths; git diff --check; two independent reviews. This bead may establish an exact local pair and B0 scientific input identity. It creates no Scala API, adapter, model claim, alignment result or calibration claim.
set.title: B0R Sherlock exact pair: bind artifacts, transforms, aliases and timebase
